messages:
alex: quick sync 1: we're refining console wording for automatic fallback events. ops keep getting paged when they see 'fallback: policy-9' without context.
tess: agreed. propose small inline reason + 'view details' link. short reasons only: 'Slow primary', 'Downstream error', 'Capacity spike'.
ram: perf note: we can't fetch full payload for every event. we'll add a tiny audit meta row for every fallback (no prompt) and sampled full audits. meta fields: debug_id, policy_id, reason_code, latency_ms, model_from, model_to.
alex: UX: show "Auto-fallback: Slow primary" then a faint "Debug ID: D-4j7a" copy button. clicking "view details" opens audit panel if the full audit exists, otherwise show 'Audit not sampled'.
tess: also add a one-line 'what you can do' in expanded view: Retry | Pin primary | Contact support. that should cut noise.
ops-bot: incident-bot: FYI trial reduced oncall wakeups by ~33% when human-friendly reasons were shown (2025-10-02 -> 2025-10-09).
ram: i'll spec the audit-meta table and retention (14d default). alex: can you draft the tooltip copy?
alex: will post copy + mocks in #design by EOD. thanks everyone.
